title: Comment "Human" and I'll send you the full guide 👇 What happens when you ask Claude to humanize
description: Comment "Human" and I'll send you the full guide 👇 What happens when you ask Claude to humanize your text so it passes every AI detector? I tried this and the results came back as 0% AI generated. Here's how: 1. Tell Claude: "I want you to humanize all my text moving forward so it doesn't sound like AI." 2. Go to the Wikipedia page on signs of AI writing and have Claude list every single pattern that gives away AI text 3. Tell it to never do any of those things Claude stops using every obvious tell like em dashes, filler phrases, and that robotic tone. Here's the trick: Stay in the same chat, type /, choose Skill Creator, and say: "Build me a personal humanizer skill based off everything we just found so I never have to explain this again." Claude builds you your own custom humanizer skill. Install it and now just type /human before you write anything. It comes back as 0% AI detected every single time. #ai #claude #claudeskills #aihumanizer #chatgpt
